crazy_reel.label: Reel nudge (crazy)
crazy_reel.note: In-engine base-game reel NUDGE (user-confirmed 2026-06-17: appears -> a reel moves once). A vertical 3-symbol crazy_up/crazy/crazy_down block lands on a SINGLE reel (96.6% single-column) and slides through the 3-row window at 5 offsets. ~10.09% of paid spins; win-rate 36.1% vs 17.6% baseline (x2.06); 87.5% of crazy-round wins run THROUGH the nudged reel (payline column basis: col = pos // 100 - 1); carries 25.6% of all win (23.31 RTP pp). crazy* never itself carries a pid. INTRA-ST1, no separate event ST. Fully captured by stateless testspin -> NOT out-of-engine; data RTP is complete. Money-agnostic dimension feeding nudge_dynamics -> _stDimNudge.

trigger.note: Single-SpinType base game; no separate feature/event ST fires in this mode (GameplayTriggerType constant 0, ReMarks empty). The crazy-reel nudge is INTRA-ST1 (no transition, no second ST) and is declared via the spin_types.1.crazy_reel dimension block, not as a trigger.
